name: Abell 1185, field 2 (Hubble)
blurb: Abell 1185, a crowded galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: abell1185f2new-hubble
story: Abell 1185 is a chaotic cluster of at least 82 galaxies, many of them interacting, with globular clusters wandering between the galaxies. This is one of the tiles Hubble used to watch a young cluster still assembling, and how stars form in and between its galaxies.

claims.text: Abell 1185 is a chaotic galaxy cluster of at least 82 galaxies, many of them interacting
Abell 1185 has wandering globular clusters not attached to any particular galaxy
Hubble program 17212 surveys Abell 1185, a nearby rich cluster still assembling, to study galactic and intergalactic stellar populations; F2-NEW is one of its fields
